description.value:
You've begun fusing technical know-how with the Force. Choose two tech powers of a level no higher than your Max Power Level (shown on the guardian table); for you, these count as both universal force powers and tech powers, and they don't count against the Powers Known total on the guardian table.

You learn two more such powers at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. Whenever you gain a level in this class, you may swap one tech power you know for another of a level no higher than your Max Power Level.
